# Flint Public API models

[API reference](REFERENCE.md) · [Runtime guide](RUNTIME.md)

Fields below describe the API's declared shape. Inputs omit read-only fields; responses omit write-only fields and preserve unknown fields and enum values. Node input types add the suffix `Input`. PHP operation responses use presence-aware classes; nested values use the shapes below.

Exact numeric strings preserve JSON numeric precision. For a minor-unit amount, `"100"` is 100 minor units (USD 1.00), not USD 100.00. Use the field's documented units.

## BuyerCreditNote

The buyer-visible view of a credit note. Drafts are never returned, and how much credit is left to allocate is omitted.

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `credit_note_id` | Required | string |  |
| `credit_note_lines` | Required | Array of [CreditNoteLine](MODELS.md#creditnoteline) |  |
| `credit_note_number` | Required | string | Assigned at issue and stable from then on. Absent while the credit note is a draft. |
| `invoice_id` | Required | string |  |
| `issued_at` | Required | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |
| `memo` | Optional | string |  |
| `reason` | Required | string | Why the invoice is being corrected. Shown on the credit note document. Values: "returned_goods", "order_adjustment", "billing_error", "goodwill", "other". |
| `status` | Required | string | draft while the credit note is editable, issued once it is numbered and frozen, void once retired. Values: "issued", "void". |
| `total_money` | Required | object | The face value of the credit note, the sum of its lines. |
| `voided_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |

## BuyerInstructionsConfig

Controls buyer instructions for a delivery option. Omit it from a method configuration to disable instruction collection.

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | Required | boolean | Whether checkout collects buyer instructions. |
| `label` | Optional | string | Checkout field label, without leading or trailing whitespace. Clients use a delivery-type default when omitted. maxLength: 255. |
| `placeholder` | Optional | string | Checkout field placeholder, without leading or trailing whitespace. Clients use a delivery-type default when omitted. maxLength: 500. |
| `required` | Required | boolean | Whether the buyer must enter instructions before selecting the option. Requires enabled=true. |

## CallerSuppliedDeliveryOutcomeRequest



| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount_money` | Optional | [MoneyValue](MODELS.md#moneyvalue) |  |
| `expires_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |
| `failure_category` | Optional | string | Why Flint could not calculate the method and the action that can make calculation succeed. - `dependency_failure`: Retry after the dependent service recovers. - `timeout`: Retry after the timed-out dependency recovers. - `malformed_response`: Fix the callback response so it matches the documented response schema, then retry. - `callback_transport_failure`: Restore callback DNS, TLS, network connectivity, and response timing, then retry. - `callback_result_invalid`: Fix the callback result fields or values identified by the callback logs, then retry. - `pricing_failure`: Fix the method pricing configuration or matching rate, then retry. - `schedule_failure`: Fix the method schedule, timezone, or requested window, then retry. - `geography_failure`: Fix the destination, origin, or geographic configuration, then retry. - `routing_failure`: Fix inventory routing or origin assignment, then retry. - `address_verification_failed`: Correct the address fields rejected by verification, then retry. - `address_could_not_be_verified`: Confirm or correct the address, or retry when address verification is available. Values: "dependency_failure", "timeout", "malformed_response", "callback_transport_failure", "callback_result_invalid", "pricing_failure", "schedule_failure", "geography_failure", "routing_failure", "address_verification_failed", "address_could_not_be_verified". |
| `merchant_reference` | Optional | string | maxLength: 500. |
| `offered_windows` | Optional | Array of [DeliveryWindowResource](MODELS.md#deliverywindowresource) |  |
| `retryable` | Optional | boolean |  |
| `selection_guarantee_expires_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |
| `service_level` | Optional | string |  |
| `type` | Required | string | Values: "available", "unavailable", "cannot_calculate". |
| `unavailable_reason` | Optional | string | Why the method is unavailable and the action that can make it eligible. - `destination_not_served`: Use a destination covered by this method or choose another method. - `pickup_unavailable`: Choose an available pickup method or location. - `no_window_available`: Choose another offered window or a method with availability for the requested time. - `eligibility_no_match`: Inspect eligibility_mismatches, then change the relevant buyer facts or method eligibility rule. - `pricing_unavailable`: Add or activate a matching rate, or provide the required caller-supplied price. - `inventory_unavailable`: Choose an origin or method backed by available inventory. Values: "destination_not_served", "pickup_unavailable", "no_window_available", "eligibility_no_match", "pricing_unavailable", "inventory_unavailable". |
| `window_end_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |
| `window_start_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |

Variants: any, any, any.

## Capability

Merchant capability readiness for a payment or money movement capability.

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Payment capabilities describe transaction acceptance readiness; money movement capabilities describe payout and balance movement readiness. Values: "accept_card_payments", "save_payment_methods", "accept_affirm_payments", "receive_payouts", "create_standard_payouts", "manage_payout_destinations", "manage_payout_settings". |

| `observed_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp for the source state used to evaluate this capability. Format: date-time. |
| `requirements` | Required | object | Merchant requirements that affect this capability. |
| `status` | Required | string | Current readiness status for this capability. Values: "ready", "blocked", "pending", "not_available". |

## CreateOrderTip

Requested tip expressed as either a flat amount or a percentage. Send exactly one of amount_money or percent.

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount_money` | Optional | any | Flat requested tip in the order currency. The amount must be at least 1 minor unit; otherwise, Flint returns INVALID_TIP_AMOUNT. For USD orders, the maximum is the larger of $1,000 or the post-discount merchandise subtotal. |
| `description` | Optional | string |  |
| `metadata` | Optional | object |  |
| `name` | Optional | string |  |
| `percent` | Optional | exact numeric string | Requested tip percentage from 1 through 100, calculated from the post-discount merchandise subtotal. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. minimum: 1. maximum: 100. multipleOf: 0.0001. |

Variants: any, any.

## CreditNote

A correction against an issued invoice. Credit notes reduce what is owed; refunds return what was already collected.

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `created_at` | Required | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |
| `credit_note_id` | Required | string |  |
| `credit_note_lines` | Required | Array of [CreditNoteLine](MODELS.md#creditnoteline) |  |
| `credit_note_number` | Optional | string | Assigned at issue and stable from then on. Absent while the credit note is a draft. |
| `external_reference_id` | Optional | string | Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system. maxLength: 255. |
| `invoice_id` | Required | string |  |
| `issued_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |
| `memo` | Optional | string | Free text shown on the credit note, up to 4096 characters. |
| `merchant_id` | Required | string |  |
| `reason` | Required | string | Why the invoice is being corrected. Shown on the credit note document. Values: "returned_goods", "order_adjustment", "billing_error", "goodwill", "other". |
| `status` | Required | string | draft while the credit note is editable, issued once it is numbered and frozen, void once retired. Values: "draft", "issued", "void". |
| `total_money` | Required | object | The face value of the credit note, the sum of its lines. |
| `unallocated_money` | Required | object | Credit still available to allocate. Equals total_money at issue, falls as credit is applied, and rises again when an allocation is reversed. |
| `updated_at` | Required | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |
| `version` | Required | exact numeric string | Current credit note version. Send this as expected_version when updating the draft. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. minimum: 1. Response only. |
| `voided_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |

## CreditNoteAllocation

One application of credit to the invoice. Allocations are append-only: a reversal sets reversed_at rather than removing the row.

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allocated_at` | Required | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |
| `amount_money` | Required | object | Credit applied to the invoice balance. |
| `credit_note_allocation_id` | Required | string |  |
| `credit_note_id` | Required | string |  |
| `idempotency_key` | Required | string | The key the caller sent when allocating. It is this allocation's identity and is filterable on the allocations list. |
| `invoice_id` | Required | string |  |
| `reversed_at` | Optional | string | When the allocation was reversed and its credit returned. Absent while the allocation stands. Format: date-time. |

## DeliveryCandidateOutcomeResource



| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `address_advisories` | Optional | Array of [DeliveryAddressAdvisoryResource](MODELS.md#deliveryaddressadvisoryresource) |  |
| `failure_category` | Optional | string | Why Flint could not calculate the method and the action that can make calculation succeed. - `dependency_failure`: Retry after the dependent service recovers. - `timeout`: Retry after the timed-out dependency recovers. - `malformed_response`: Fix the callback response so it matches the documented response schema, then retry. - `callback_transport_failure`: Restore callback DNS, TLS, network connectivity, and response timing, then retry. - `callback_circuit_open`: Restore the callback and wait for circuit recovery before retrying. - `callback_result_invalid`: Fix the callback result fields or values identified by the callback logs, then retry. - `callback_unavailable`: Restore the configured callback endpoint or choose a non-callback pricing strategy. - `pricing_failure`: Fix the method pricing configuration or matching rate, then retry. - `schedule_failure`: Fix the method schedule, timezone, or requested window, then retry. - `option_lifetime_too_short`: Increase the method minimum option lifetime or return a later callback expiry. - `geography_failure`: Fix the destination, origin, or geographic configuration, then retry. - `routing_failure`: Fix inventory routing or origin assignment, then retry. - `invalid_configuration`: Correct the invalid delivery configuration identified by diagnostics, then retry. - `invalid_buyer_input`: Correct the buyer input identified by the outcome, then retry. - `address_verification_failed`: Correct the address fields rejected by verification, then retry. - `address_could_not_be_verified`: Confirm or correct the address, or retry when address verification is available. Values: "dependency_failure", "timeout", "malformed_response", "callback_transport_failure", "callback_circuit_open", "callback_result_invalid", "callback_unavailable", "pricing_failure", "schedule_failure", "option_lifetime_too_short", "geography_failure", "routing_failure", "invalid_configuration", "invalid_buyer_input", "address_verification_failed", "address_could_not_be_verified". |
| `input_requirements` | Optional | Array of [DeliveryInputRequirement](MODELS.md#deliveryinputrequirement) |  |
| `option` | Optional | [DeliveryOptionProjection](MODELS.md#deliveryoptionprojection) |  |
| `retryable` | Optional | boolean |  |
| `type` | Required | string | Values: "available", "unavailable", "input_required", "cannot_calculate", "requires_checkout_context", "unsupported_in_preview". |
| `unavailable_reason` | Optional | string | Why the method is unavailable and the action that can make it eligible. - `destination_not_served`: Use a destination covered by this method or choose another method. - `pickup_unavailable`: Choose an available pickup method or location. - `no_window_available`: Choose another offered window or a method with availability for the requested time. - `eligibility_no_match`: Inspect eligibility_mismatches, then change the relevant buyer facts or method eligibility rule. - `method_type_not_allowed`: Choose a method type allowed by every line item in the choice group. - `pricing_unavailable`: Add or activate a matching rate, or provide the required caller-supplied price. - `inventory_unavailable`: Choose an origin or method backed by available inventory. Values: "destination_not_served", "pickup_unavailable", "no_window_available", "eligibility_no_match", "method_type_not_allowed", "pricing_unavailable", "inventory_unavailable". |

Variants: any, any, any, any, any, any.

## DeliveryMethodConfiguration



| Field | Presence | Type | Description |

| `buyer_instructions` | Optional | object | Controls whether checkout collects buyer instructions for this method. |

Omit it to derive shipping for shipment methods, delivery for local delivery, or service_fee for pickup. It does not currently change the automatic rate. Values: "service_fee", "shipping", "delivery", "handling", "surcharge". |
| `eligibility` | Optional | Alternative shapes (see declared variants) | Conditions that decide where this method is offered. Omit this field to offer the method everywhere the merchant serves. |
| `estimate` | Required | object | The buyer-visible delivery or pickup estimate. Use type none when the merchant makes no timing promise. |
| `minimum_option_lifetime_seconds` | Required | exact numeric string | Minimum remaining quote lifetime required before Flint offers this method. Required for calculated, callback, and caller_supplied pricing; defaults to 0 for other pricing. Must be less than Flint's 15-minute quote lifetime. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. minimum: 0. maximum: 899. |
| `offer_windows` | Required | boolean | Whether buyers choose from enumerated schedule windows. Flint derives this value for new writes and returns it for stored-revision compatibility. |
| `origin` | Required | Alternative shapes (see declared variants) | Where delivery starts. A method can use a fixed location or a delivery location set; origin.type determines allocation or buyer pickup behavior. |
| `pricing` | Required | Alternative shapes (see declared variants) | How Flint calculates the delivery charge. |
| `public_details` | Optional | object | Buyer-visible structured details supplied by the merchant. |
| `quote_input_fields` | Optional | Array of string | Address and coordinate fields a callback method requires and is allowed to receive. maxItems: 12. |
| `recipient_requirements` | Optional | Array of [DeliveryRecipientRequirement](MODELS.md#deliveryrecipientrequirement) | Buyer contact fields required when selecting this method. |
| `selection_guarantee_seconds` | Required | exact numeric string | How long Flint guarantees a selected price beyond its quote expiry. Defaults to 0, which uses the option expiry. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. minimum: 0. |
| `taxable` | Optional | boolean or null | Whether the delivery charge is taxable. Omit or send null to inherit tax.default_delivery_taxable from effective merchant settings. |

## DeliveryProfileConfiguration



| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowed_types` | Optional | Array of string | Required as a non-empty unique list when requirement is required. quote accepts shipment, pickup, and local_delivery. manual accepts digital and service. |
| `combination_policy` | Optional | string | Required for quote resolution and forbidden when requirement is none or resolution_mode is manual. Controls which delivery obligations can share a choice group. Values: "combine_when_compatible", "separate_profile", "separate_line_item", "fulfill_alone". |
| `dimensions` | Optional | object | Optional physical dimensions used by quote planning. Forbidden when requirement is none or resolution_mode is manual. |
| `origin_policy` | Optional | object | Required for quote resolution and forbidden for none or manual resolution. fixed_location requires location_id. inventory_routing forbids location_id and applies only to tracked inventory. method_origin forbids location_id. |
| `requirement` | Required | string | Whether delivery planning applies. none forbids every other configuration field. required also requires resolution_mode and allowed_types, plus the fields required by that resolution mode. Values: "none", "required". |
| `resolution_mode` | Optional | string | Required when requirement is required. quote plans physical delivery and requires origin_policy, combination_policy, and splitting_policy. manual supports digital and service items and forbids physical planning fields. Values: "quote", "manual". |
| `splitting_policy` | Optional | string | Required for quote resolution and forbidden when requirement is none or resolution_mode is manual. Controls whether a line item quantity can be split across delivery assignments. Values: "whole_line_item", "quantity_split_allowed". |
| `weight` | Optional | object | Optional physical weight used by quote planning. Forbidden when requirement is none or resolution_mode is manual. |

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |

| `status` | Required | string | Current package lifecycle state. - `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off. - `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff. - `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier. - `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network. - `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route. - `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery. - `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery. - `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue. - `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin. - `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery. Values: "created", "packed", "shipped", "in_transit", "out_for_delivery", "delivered", "delivery_attempted", "exception", "returned", "voided". |
| `supported_actions` | Required | Array of string | Read-only actions currently supported for this package. Response only. |

| `tracking_url` | Optional | string |  |
| `updated_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |
| `version` | Required | exact numeric string | Monotonic package version for expected_version checks. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: uint64. minimum: 1. Response only. |

| `pickup_details` | Optional | [PickupFulfillmentDetails](MODELS.md#pickupfulfillmentdetails) |  |
| `quantity_effect` | Optional | string | Read-only current quantity accounting behavior for this fulfillment state. Values: "preserve", "fulfill", "release". Response only. |
| `recipient` | Optional | [FulfillmentRecipient](MODELS.md#fulfillmentrecipient) |  |
| `request_status` | Required | string | Provider acceptance state, independent from fulfillment work progress. The accept action sets this field to accepted while status remains pending. Values: "pending", "accepted". Response only. |
| `service_details` | Optional | [ServiceFulfillmentDetails](MODELS.md#servicefulfillmentdetails) |  |
| `shipments` | Optional | Array of [ExpandedShipmentSummary](MODELS.md#expandedshipmentsummary) | Response only. |
| `status` | Required | string | Public work status. Fulfillments with request_status accepted project to status pending. Fulfillments with outcome.outcome_type no_show project to status failed. A fulfillment with active_hold projects to its public work status from before the hold. - `pending`: Work has not started. Start, schedule, accept, hold, cancel, or fail it as supported_actions allows. - `in_progress`: Work has started and is not yet ready or complete. - `ready`: The fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion. - `completed`: All fulfillment work completed successfully. - `canceled`: The fulfillment was intentionally canceled and will not continue. - `failed`: The fulfillment could not be completed. Resolve the recorded reason before creating replacement work. - `scheduled`: The fulfillment is scheduled for its recorded service window. - `preparing`: Warehouse or provider preparation is underway. - `picked`: The assigned items have been picked. - `packed`: The assigned items have been packed. - `dispatched`: The fulfillment left its origin for delivery or handoff. Values: "pending", "in_progress", "ready", "completed", "canceled", "failed", "scheduled", "preparing", "picked", "packed", "dispatched". Response only. |
| `supported_actions` | Required | Array of string | Read-only actions currently supported for this fulfillment. Response only. |
| `type` | Required | string | Values: "shipment", "pickup", "local_delivery", "digital", "service". |
| `updated_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. Response only. |
| `version` | Required | exact numeric string | Monotonic fulfillment version for expected_version checks. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: uint64. minimum: 1. Response only. |

Named, version-fenced rules that decide which Locations serve demand and in what order.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `configuration` | Required | [InventoryAllocationPolicyConfiguration](MODELS.md#inventoryallocationpolicyconfiguration) |  |

| `external_reference_id` | Optional | string | Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system. maxLength: 255. |
| `inventory_allocation_policy_id` | Required | string |  |
| `metadata` | Required | object |  |
| `name` | Required | string |  |

## InventoryAllocationPolicyConfiguration



| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `location_groups` | Required | Array of [PolicyLocation](MODELS.md#policylocation) | Locations ranked into priority groups. Routing prefers the lowest group priority, then the lowest location ID. minItems: 1. maxItems: 25. |
| `maximum_locations_per_assignment` | Required | integer | Upper bound on how many Locations one assignment may use. Format: int32. minimum: 1. maximum: 10. |
| `splitting_behavior` | Required | string | single_location fails rather than splitting demand across Locations; split_when_required allows a split when no single Location can serve the whole request. Values: "single_location", "split_when_required". |
| `within_group_order` | Optional | string | Tie-break inside a priority group. Ascending location ID keeps assignments reproducible. Values: "location_id_ascending". |

## InventoryLevel

The quantity state of one inventory item at one Location.

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `available_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | Derived and never written: on_hand minus unavailable, held, committed, and safety stock. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |
| `committed_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | Units promised to accepted orders. Still physically present until fulfillment consumes them. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |
| `created_at` | Required | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |
| `damaged_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | On-hand units known to be damaged. Not sellable. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |
| `held_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | Units claimed by an open reservation that has not been committed. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |
| `incoming_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | Units recorded as inbound but not yet on hand. Does not count toward availability. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |
| `inventory_item_id` | Required | string |  |
| `inventory_level_claim_revision` | Required | exact numeric string | Advances only when held or committed quantities change. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |
| `inventory_level_id` | Required | string |  |
| `inventory_level_physical_revision` | Required | exact numeric string | Advances only when on-hand or condition quantities change. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |
| `location_id` | Required | string |  |
| `on_hand_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | Units physically present at the Location, in any condition. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |
| `quality_control_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | On-hand units awaiting inspection. Not sellable. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |
| `quarantined_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | On-hand units isolated for review. Not sellable. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |
| `safety_stock_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | Buffer withheld from allocation. Change it with PATCH /v1/inventory-levels/{inventory_level_id}. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |
| `shortage_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | Derived: claims exceeding sellable physical stock. Positive only after stock is lost, damaged, or corrected down. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. |

## Location

A physical or logical place a merchant operates from. Locations own geography and, when inventory is enabled, an inventory capability block.

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | Optional | object | Published postal address. |
| `coordinate` | Optional | object | Published geographic coordinate. |
| `coordinate_source` | Optional | string or null | Source of the stored latitude and longitude. Values: "merchant_supplied", "geocoded", null. |
| `created_at` | Required | string | Time the Location was created. Format: date-time. |
| `external_reference_id` | Optional | string | Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system. maxLength: 255. |
| `geography_revision` | Required | exact numeric string | Optimistic-concurrency revision for geography writes. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: uint64. minimum: 0. |
| `inventory` | Optional | object | Inventory allocation capability at this Location. |
| `location_id` | Required | string | Stable Location ID. |
| `metadata` | Required | object | Caller-owned metadata. |
| `name` | Required | string | Merchant-facing Location name. |
| `normalized_address` | Optional | object | Provider-normalized address used for geography evaluation. |
| `status` | Required | string | Current Location lifecycle status. Values: "active", "inactive", "archived". |
| `timezone` | Required | string | IANA timezone for local schedules. |
| `updated_at` | Required | string | Time the Location last changed. Format: date-time. |
| `validation_failure_reason` | Optional | string | Normalized reason address validation failed. |
| `validation_status` | Required | string | Address validation status. Values: "not_validated", "validated", "merchant_verified". |
| `version` | Required | exact numeric string | Optimistic-concurrency version for general Location writes. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: uint64. minimum: 0. |

| `activity_type` | Required | string | Stable but open activity string. Flint documents exactly the values it emits today; clients must still render unknown future values gracefully. |

| `created_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. |

| `external_system` | Optional | string | External carrier, aggregator, or fulfillment platform name for this package. Set with external_reference_id to enable duplicate detection and replay for that provider reference; without external_reference_id this is stored as provenance only. |
| `fulfillment_id` | Required | string | Response only. |
| `label_url` | Optional | string | Merchant or integration supplied HTTPS shipping-label URL for authenticated merchant workflows. Non-Flint URLs must include external_system for provenance. Flint does not currently manage label file hosting or buyer-facing label downloads. |

| `order` | Optional | Alternative shapes (see declared variants) | Response only. |
| `order_id` | Required | string | Response only. |
| `package_id` | Required | string | Response only. |
| `service_code` | Optional | string |  |
| `shipment_id` | Required | string | Response only. |
| `shipped_at` | Optional | string | Package handoff timestamp. Format: date-time. Response only. |
| `status` | Required | string | Current package lifecycle state. Package states are the source used to derive shipment status. - `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off. - `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff. - `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier. - `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network. - `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route. - `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery. - `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery. - `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue. - `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin. - `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery. Values: "created", "packed", "shipped", "in_transit", "out_for_delivery", "delivered", "delivery_attempted", "exception", "returned", "voided". Response only. |
| `status_reason` | Optional | string |  |
| `supported_actions` | Required | Array of string | Read-only actions currently supported for this package. Response only. |
| `tracking_number` | Optional | string |  |
| `tracking_url` | Optional | string | Absolute HTTPS carrier tracking URL. Embedded URL credentials are rejected. |
| `updated_at` | Optional | string | Last update timestamp. Format: date-time. Response only. |
| `version` | Required | exact numeric string | Monotonic package version for expected_version checks. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: uint64. minimum: 1. Response only. |
| `weight` | Optional | [ShippingWeight](MODELS.md#shippingweight) |  |

## PendingPaymentAction

Client-side action required before continuing a payment. Resume an order through PayOrder with payment_attempt_id, or continue a standalone PaymentIntent through its confirm endpoint without a replacement credential.

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action_type` | Required | string | Product-level action type. payment_authentication applies to a payment leg; payment_method_authentication applies to saving a future-billing payment method. Values: "payment_authentication", "payment_method_authentication". |
| `client_action` | Required | object | Direct browser authority required to finish this action before continuing through Flint. Unlike collection guidance, this payload includes a client secret. |
| `pending_action_id` | Required | string | Stable Flint action ID. Use this to deduplicate a repeated action projection while resuming an attempt. |
| `subject` | Required | object | The attempt subject that requires browser action. Exactly one of payment_intent or setup_payment_source is present. |

## PromotionApplicationMethod

Canonical REST shape is flat: send type plus the effect fields on this object. Responses always use this flat shape.

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allocation` | Optional | string | How the effect is applied across the matched items or charges. each applies the effect to every matched item independently: a fixed amount_off is charged per item (10 USD off 3 items discounts 30 USD, each capped at the item price), and a percent_off is taken from each item. across applies the effect once to the matched set as a whole: a fixed amount_off is the whole amount one time (10 USD off the group total, not prorated per item), and a percent_off is taken from the combined subtotal. For percent_off the two produce the same total and differ only in how the discount is attributed to individual line items; for amount_off they differ by the number of matched items, so set it deliberately. Defaults to each for line_item and service_charge promotions and across for order promotions. max_discounted_quantity requires each. Values: "each", "across". |
| `amount_off_money` | Optional | [MoneyValue](MODELS.md#moneyvalue) |  |
| `applies_to` | Optional | string | Reserved for future subscription promotion support. Do not send this field in requests. Values: "order", "line_item", "subscription", "subscription_item". Response only. |
| `buy_min_quantity` | Optional | integer | Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Format: int32. minimum: 1. |
| `calculation_basis` | Optional | string | Basis for merchandise promotion calculations. Omit for service_charge promotions because service-charge discounts are calculated from the targeted charges. Values: "subtotal_pre_tax", "subtotal_post_tax". |
| `currency_options` | Optional | object |  |
| `discounted_item_rules` | Optional | Alternative shapes (see declared variants) | Which line items receive the discount. Required for service_charge promotions, and for line_item promotions whose eligibility_rules include any non-line-item condition (for example order.subtotal or a customer condition). It is optional only when eligibility_rules consist entirely of line_item.* conditions (plus matched_items.subtotal), in which case the matched items are used as the target. Omitting it otherwise returns DISCOUNTED_ITEM_RULES_REQUIRED. |
| `get_percent_off` | Optional | exact numeric string | Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. minimum: 1. maximum: 100. multipleOf: 0.0001. |
| `get_quantity` | Optional | integer | Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Format: int32. minimum: 1. |
| `max_applications_per_order` | Optional | integer | Format: int32. minimum: 1. |
| `max_discounted_quantity` | Optional | integer | Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Format: int32. minimum: 1. |
| `percent_off` | Optional | exact numeric string | Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. minimum: 1. maximum: 100. multipleOf: 0.0001. |
| `qualifying_item_rules` | Optional | Alternative shapes (see declared variants) | A rule group is exactly one of three forms, never a blend: an array of rules for a simple list (an implicit AND), an object with only all for nested AND, or an object with only any for OR. The all and any arrays contain rules or nested rule groups. There is no rules key. Sending a rules key, an unexpected key, or both all and any is rejected with INVALID_RULE_GROUP. |
| `recurrence` | Optional | object | Optional on order promotion writes, but only recurrence.type = once is accepted. Subscription recurrence values are reserved for future subscription promotion support. |
| `reward_selection` | Optional | string | Values: "cheapest", "highest_price", "first_added". |
| `type` | Optional | string | Values: "percent_off", "amount_off", "buy_x_get_y". |

Variants: any, any, any.

## PromotionRule



| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `attribute` | Required | string | Field the rule tests. The attribute fixes the value type and the operators that are legal for it: money attributes accept comparison operators but not eq or in, booleans accept eq only, and so on. The full attribute/type/operator matrix is machine-readable in x-flint-rule-attributes on this schema. metadata.&lt;key> reads a string from the customer's metadata and accepts the string operators. A disallowed operator is rejected at create time with INVALID_OPERATOR, whose message names the operators allowed for the attribute. |
| `currency_options` | Optional | object |  |
| `operator` | Required | string | Values: "eq", "ne", "gt", "gte", "lt", "lte", "in", "contains", "is_defined". |
| `values` | Optional | Array of [PromotionRuleValue](MODELS.md#promotionrulevalue) |  |

## PromotionRuleGroup

A rule group is exactly one of three forms, never a blend: an array of rules for a simple list (an implicit AND), an object with only all for nested AND, or an object with only any for OR. The all and any arrays contain rules or nested rule groups. There is no rules key. Sending a rules key, an unexpected key, or both all and any is rejected with INVALID_RULE_GROUP.

Variants: Array of [PromotionRule](MODELS.md#promotionrule), object, object.

## PromotionRuleValue

Rule comparison value. Use a primitive string, number, boolean, or a money object.

Variants: string, ExactNumber input; exact numeric string response, boolean, object.

## ReturnLineDecision



| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowed_resolution_types` | Optional | Array of string |  |
| `approved_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Approved quantity ranges from zero through the return line's requested_quantity. Declining any requested quantity requires decline_reason; decline context is invalid when all requested quantity is approved. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. minimum: 0. |
| `decision_basis` | Required | string | Which decision semantics this line uses. With policy_evaluation you accept the recorded policy proposal and send only approved_quantity plus decline context; the explicit fields are rejected. With explicit you state the outcome yourself and return_required_quantity is required, and approving any quantity also requires allowed_resolution_types and resolution_mode. A resolution_mode of automatic additionally requires selected_resolution_type, and any return_required_quantity above 0 additionally requires a receiving_location_id whose Location has a postal address. Values: "policy_evaluation", "explicit". |
| `decline_reason` | Optional | string | Values: "not_eligible", "quantity_unavailable", "evidence_missing", "suspected_abuse", "merchant_discretion", "other". |
| `decline_reason_message` | Optional | string |  |
| `is_inspection_required` | Optional | boolean |  |
| `override_reason` | Optional | string | Required when an explicit decision changes a valid policy proposal. Invalid without a policy to override. Values: "customer_service_exception", "policy_correction", "risk_review", "merchant_discretion", "other". |
| `override_reason_message` | Optional | string |  |
| `receiving_location_id` | Optional | string |  |
| `refund_timing` | Optional | string | Values: "after_approval", "after_handoff", "after_receipt", "after_inspection", "manual". |
| `resolution_mode` | Optional | string | Values: "automatic", "manual". |
| `return_line_item_id` | Required | string |  |
| `return_required_quantity` | Optional | exact numeric string | How much of the approved quantity the buyer must physically send back; fractional quantities are not supported. Set 0 for a returnless refund, where the buyer keeps the merchandise and the Return still settles the money. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. minimum: 0. |
| `selected_resolution_type` | Optional | string | Values: "refund", "exchange", "replacement", "no_monetary_action". |

Variants: any, any.

For tracked merchandise, it also creates an inventory receipt and movement. Untracked merchandise has no inventory effect. If the Return line requires inspection, creation waits for an accepted inspection. manual leaves inventory unchanged until an explicit disposition succeeds. When omitted, the value defaults to automatic. Values: "automatic", "manual". |

| `refund_timing` | Optional | string | When a refund may execute. Required whenever allowed_resolution_types contains refund. after_handoff and after_receipt require is_merchandise_return_required, and after_inspection also requires is_inspection_required. Values: "after_approval", "after_handoff", "after_receipt", "after_inspection", "manual". |

| `resolution_selection_mode` | Optional | string | Values: "policy_default", "buyer_requested". |

## ReturnProcessDecision



| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowed_resolution_types` | Optional | Array of string |  |
| `approved_quantity` | Required | exact numeric string | Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Approved quantity ranges from zero through the return line's requested_quantity. Declining any requested quantity requires decline_reason; decline context is invalid when all requested quantity is approved. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. minimum: 0. |
| `decision_basis` | Required | string | Which decision semantics this line uses. With policy_evaluation you accept the recorded policy proposal and send only approved_quantity plus decline context; the explicit fields are rejected. With explicit you state the outcome yourself and return_required_quantity is required, and approving any quantity also requires allowed_resolution_types and resolution_mode. A resolution_mode of automatic additionally requires selected_resolution_type, and any return_required_quantity above 0 additionally requires a receiving_location_id whose Location has a postal address. Values: "policy_evaluation", "explicit". |
| `decline_reason` | Optional | string | Values: "not_eligible", "quantity_unavailable", "evidence_missing", "suspected_abuse", "merchant_discretion", "other". |
| `decline_reason_message` | Optional | string |  |
| `is_inspection_required` | Optional | boolean |  |
| `override_reason` | Optional | string | Required when an explicit decision changes a valid policy proposal. Invalid without a policy to override. Values: "customer_service_exception", "policy_correction", "risk_review", "merchant_discretion", "other". |
| `override_reason_message` | Optional | string |  |
| `receiving_location_id` | Optional | string |  |
| `refund_timing` | Optional | string | Values: "after_approval", "after_handoff", "after_receipt", "after_inspection", "manual". |
| `resolution_mode` | Optional | string | Values: "automatic", "manual". |
| `return_required_quantity` | Optional | exact numeric string | How much of the approved quantity the buyer must physically send back; fractional quantities are not supported. Set 0 for a returnless refund, where the buyer keeps the merchandise and the Return still settles the money. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: int64. minimum: 0. |
| `selected_resolution_type` | Optional | string | Values: "refund", "exchange", "replacement", "no_monetary_action". |

Variants: any, any.

## Shipment



| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `created_at` | Optional | string | Creation timestamp. Format: date-time. Response only. |
| `delivered_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. Response only. |
| `direction` | Required | string | Values: "outbound", "return". Response only. |
| `external_reference_id` | Optional | string | Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system. Caller-owned shipment identifier in external_system. Set with external_system to enable duplicate detection and replay for that provider reference. maxLength: 255. |
| `external_system` | Optional | string | External carrier, aggregator, or fulfillment platform name for this shipment. Set with external_reference_id to enable duplicate detection and replay for that provider reference; without external_reference_id this is stored as provenance only. |
| `fulfillment_id` | Required | string | Response only. |
| `handed_off_at` | Optional | string | Carrier acceptance timestamp. For return shipments, this can satisfy an after_handoff execution gate for the declared return_line_items. Format: date-time. Response only. |
| `metadata` | Optional | object |  |
| `order` | Optional | Alternative shapes (see declared variants) | Response only. |
| `order_id` | Required | string | Response only. |
| `package_count` | Required | integer | Total number of packages attached to the shipment, including voided packages. Format: int32. minimum: 0. Response only. |
| `return_id` | Optional | string |  |
| `return_line_items` | Optional | Array of [ReturnShipmentLineItemAllocation](MODELS.md#returnshipmentlineitemallocation) |  |
| `shipment_id` | Required | string | Response only. |
| `shipped_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. Response only. |
| `status` | Required | string | Read-only shipment state derived from the shipment's package states. An empty shipment remains a created draft. - `created`: The shipment leg exists but has not been packed or handed off. - `packed`: The shipment leg is packed and awaiting carrier handoff. - `shipped`: The shipment leg was handed to the carrier. - `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the shipment through its network. - `out_for_delivery`: The shipment is on its final delivery route. - `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery. - `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery. - `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue. - `returned`: The shipment was returned toward or to its origin. - `voided`: The shipment was voided and will not continue through delivery. Values: "created", "packed", "shipped", "in_transit", "out_for_delivery", "delivered", "delivery_attempted", "exception", "returned", "voided". Response only. |
| `updated_at` | Optional | string | Last update timestamp. Format: date-time. Response only. |
| `version` | Required | exact numeric string | Monotonic shipment version for expected_version checks. Use an exact numeric string, not a floating-point number. Format: uint64. minimum: 1. Response only. |

## StripeClientAuthority

One-time client authority for the named Stripe object. This payload always names the Stripe.js call and carries its client secret.

| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `client_secret` | Required | string | Stripe client secret for the named PaymentIntent or SetupIntent. |
| `stripe_js_call` | Required | string | Stripe.js operation to perform now. confirm_setup applies to client_setup. Standalone PaymentIntents use payment_collection plus server confirmation instead of initial confirm_payment authority. Values: "confirm_payment", "confirm_setup". |

## WebhookEndpoint



| Field | Presence | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api_version` | Required | string | A dated API version pins this endpoint. The value default follows the endpoint owner's merchant default at delivery time, including retries. Deliveries never use a newer version than the event's recorded version. |
| `api_version_changed_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. Response only. |
| `api_version_previous` | Optional | string | Response only. |
| `created_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. Response only. |
| `description` | Optional | string |  |
| `enabled` | Required | boolean |  |
| `enabled_events` | Required | Array of string | Event types this endpoint receives. Empty means all merchant-owned events. For partner_app sources, empty defaults to all app lifecycle events. For installed_merchants sources, provide at least one installed-merchant event. |
| `event_sources` | Optional | Array of string | Event sources this endpoint receives. Defaults to merchant. Use partner_app for app lifecycle events and installed_merchants for events from merchants that installed the partner app. |
| `mode` | Optional | string | Partner-source delivery mode. Valid values are test, live, and both. Mode applies to installed_merchants events; partner_app lifecycle events require both. Values: "test", "live", "both". |
| `partner_app_id` | Optional | string | Partner app that owns partner_app or installed_merchants event sources. |
| `secret` | Optional | string | Response only. |
| `updated_at` | Optional | string | RFC3339 timestamp. Format: date-time. Response only. |
| `url` | Required | string |  |
| `webhook_endpoint_id` | Required | string | Response only. |
